主要内容: On February 22, 2013, Geospace Technologies Corporation (GEOSPACE) entered into a Third Amendment to the Loan Agreement dated March 2, 2011, and a Note Modification, Renewal and Extension Agreement. The Third Amendment reflects the new legal names and internal structure of the Company and its subsidiary guarantors following an internal restructuring. It also adds swap agreements entered into by the Company or any subsidiary guarantor with the lender to the definition of Loan Documents and includes the debt arising under such swap agreements in the definition of Indebtedness. The Note Extension extends the maturity date of the Revolving Promissory Note executed in connection with the 2011 Loan Agreement to March 2, 2015. The amendments modify the definitions of Indebtedness and Loan Documents to include various hedge and exchange agreements. The complete text of the Third Amendment and Note Extension is filed as Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2, respectively, and is incorporated by reference into this report.
